messages:
maria: Heads-up — Northbridge private VPC deployment window locked in for 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC. This is the final preflight thread. Can folks confirm who will be available for smoke checks + rollback?
kevin: I can be on for the window. Will be handling the routing/table updates and checking LB health.
sam: I can do app-level smoke tests and validate traces. I'll need the updated kube config & test token.
maria: Copying runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/northbridge-vpc-deploy (last updated 2026-04-10). Token & kube creds will be posted to #secrets just before start.
jon: DB migration is a minimal column add but out of an abundance of caution we'll run it in a read-only window first. Who's owning the migration rollback script?
kevin: I will own rollback for the routing and LB changes. For DB rollback, @sam do you want to own the migration undo?
sam: Happy to own DB rollback steps. I'll prepare the migration + undo in the PR. Will post commands in thread.
maria: Awesome. Two quick asks before we go green: 1) confirm smoke test list, 2) confirm fallback model/version (for inference) if primary quantized variant misbehaves.
kevin: Smoke tests (short): 1) /health 2) /v1/generate latency 50qps 3) KV-cache hit rate sanity 4) ingress TLS cert OK. If any fail -> pause.
sam: For inference fallback use model tag redwood/llama-13b:v2-fp16 as primary, fallback to redwood/llama-13b:v2-fp16-safe (lower batch) — I've added both to config.
maria: Good. I'll pin the model tags in the rollout policy. Also note: we'll enable autoscale burst only after 30m stable.
jon: Migration plan snippet (in PR):
```
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN timezone VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'UTC';
-- backfill in batches
COMMIT;
```
Rollback: `ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN timezone;` (that's the quick path if backfill causes issues).
sam: I'll add a backfill monitor (row counts by batch) to the observability dashboard and alert if latency > 200ms for reads.
maria: Who will run the initial smoke curl commands? I'll call dibs on the LB and basic health checks; @sam you'll run app-level, @kevin the infra checks, @jon the DB checks.
kevin: OK. Also, please ensure the private control plane key rotation is paused during the window — ticket #4257.
maria: Ticket 4257 paused rotation and noted in runbook.

--- 22:00 UTC deploy timeline ---
21:45 UTC: final creds to #secrets, brief sync on call (10m)
22:00 UTC: start routing switch + canary to 5%
22:10 UTC: run smoke tests (0-3m)
22:15 UTC: ramp to 25% if green
22:30 UTC: ramp to 100% after 30m stable at 25% (unless issues)

maria: If any smoke step fails we hit the pause checkpoint and run rollback checklist. Rollback owner per area: infra=kevin, app=sam, db=jon.
kevin: I'll prepare the quick rollback commands and put them in the runbook under 'rollback quick actions'.
sam: PR with migration + undo is ready, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
maria: Perfect. One more ask: please add a short note in the PR describing the specific observability assertions (SLO thresholds) used during the window.
sam: Will do.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved by maria for Northbridge private VPC on 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC. Reservation ID: RBW-20260412-07. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks deploy-bot :thumbsup: — I'm going to open a 10m Zoom at 21:50 UTC; link in calendar invite. If anyone can't make the call, please be reachable in this thread.
jon: I'll be on call. If anything looks off with migrations I'll post immediate status and invoke rollback.
kevin: I'll join too. Keeping my phone on for paging.
sam: Same. I'll run the app smoke suite at 22:10 and post results (pass/fail + logs).
maria: Great — looks like we're set. I'll do a final preflight at 21:30 to validate runbook links and secrets. If any blockers before then ping me here.
kevin: noted. :ok_hand:
maria: Thanks everyone — see you at the window.
